headlines.text: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary. Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.
UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia. It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.
US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism. The Trump administration has embraced Syria's new president, former al-Qaeda linked militant Ahmed al-Sharaa.
Moment tornado tears through southern France. The tornado has injured more than 40 people and destroyed homes in villages.
King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says. Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.
Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza. Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes. Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.
Outrage in Nepal over rape and murder of three-year-old girl. There have been protests since the girl was found dead last week, three days after she went missing.
Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles. Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.
Sonya Massey's killer Sean Grayson dies in US prison. The former police officer, whose crime reignited the debate about US police brutality, was undergoing treatment for cancer.
Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms. Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.
Four arrested over suspected poisoning of elephants in Kenya. An investigation is looking into whether the deaths were caused by pesticides sprayed on tomato crops.
China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh. Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.
Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 31. A mound of rubbish at a major waste site buried several homes in the capital, the government says.
Four arrested over boxing champion's murder in South Africa. One of the suspects is due in court on Monday to be charged with murder and attempted murder.
US plans to revoke business, tourism visas of 200,000 asylum seekers. If the action happens, it will be the largest single mass revocation of visas in US history, AP reports.
DRC’s constitutional battle: The fight over the 2028 vote. President Tshisekedi’s reform push is fuelling a battle over DRC’s 2028 succession.
Search continues in Tunisia as migrant boat sinking sparks protests. Tunisia's Ben Guerdane reels from violent protests after a boat carrying 15 people sinks, killing at least 12.
Iran war live: US slaps new sanctions on Iran, warns Tehran trade partners. US tells countries to choose between Washington and Tehran, warns Iran's trade partners they will face consequences.
How US sanctions on Iran ripple through global markets and consumers. New sanctions hit Iran's aviation, tech, and shipping sectors, amplifying pressure on global markets and energy prices.
US Supreme Court allows Trump’s mail voting restrictions to proceed. Mail balloting has long been a favourite target of US President Donald Trump.
US removes Syria from ‘state sponsor of terrorism’ list. Washington also rescinded designation of HTS, formerly led by President Ahmed al-Sharaa, as a 'terrorist' organisation.
Hakeem Jeffries, Jared Kushner meeting sparks speculation amid US midterms. Private meeting between Jeffries and Kushner fuels discussions amid contentious US midterm battle.
US public support for Iran war falls as Trump approval at record low: Poll. Falling Republican support, rising gas prices, and fears of a long conflict drive a decline in backing for the Iran war.
Iconic Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour passes away at age 79. Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour, whose work became a symbol of struggle and resistance, has died at age 79.
Displaced Palestinians in Gaza face intensifying Israeli strikes. Israel struck a makeshift tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in Deir al-Balah, killing one man.
What’s behind domestic political pressure on Ukraine’s president?. Zelenskyy rejects call from sacked minister for wartime elections.
Video: Iran reacts to US ‘economic D-Day’ sanctions. Iran’s Minister of Economy Ali Madani-Zadeh has responded to the US announcement of a new economic pressure campaign.
Ceasefire monitoring mission arrives in Democratic Republic of Congo. Fighting persists in the mineral-rich region despite ceasefire agreements.
Ambush in South Sudan kills peacekeeping troops. Armed men injured three additional peacekeepers as fears grow of the country relapsing into civil war.

Lindsay Clancy trial: Postpartum is real, but child killing demands accountability, veteran prosecutor says. Veteran child abuse prosecutor Jonathan Hatami says public support for Lindsay Clancy is overshadowing the three children she is accused of killing.

Illegal immigrant accused of fentanyl dealing linked to Virginia high school overdoses. Isaac Melendez-Carranza, an illegal immigrant from El Salvador, allegedly dealt fentanyl near Park View High School in Loudoun County, Virginia.

Houston Uber driver caught in wild police chase as officers seen on dashcam video hitching a ride in his car. The dashcam video shows Houston police riding with the Uber driver for several minutes before spotting the suspect and resuming pursuit on foot.

Abdul El-Sayed grilled on past statements on Sharia law and White supremacy, taxing the rich. Abdul El-Sayed clashed with Jesse Watters over Sharia law, wealth taxes, and his Senate race against Mike Rogers in a fiery primetime exchange.

Trump administration proposes six-figure price tag for new H-1B visas. The Department of Homeland Security proposed making the $103,265 H-1B visa fee permanent after a federal judge blocked the temporary charge.

Ex-Lakers player speaks out in defense of Enes Kanter, doubles down against WNBA's trans issue. Matt Ryan backed Enes Kanter Freedom's ejection from the Indiana Fever-Chicago Sky game, calling out the WNBA's failure to protect women's sports.

Rob Manfred addresses possibility of cancelling 2027 Major League Baseball season: 'We want to play'. Rob Manfred said Major League Baseball "wants" and is "planning" to play in 2027 but stopped short of guaranteeing no lockout as CBA talks continue.

More details about Jed York's arrest in a prostitution sting come to light and begs questions about the 49ers. Jed York responded to an ad on a known prostitution website and was intercepted near a trailer park in East Palestine, Ohio, during a police sting.

Syria off US terror blacklist after nearly 50 years as Trump admin clears investment hurdle. The United States formally removed Syria from its state sponsors of terrorism list after Marco Rubio authorized the rescission and delisted HTS.

Trump admin eyes historic mass visa revocation targeting up to 200K asylum seekers: report. The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to revoke B1 and B2 visas held by up to 200,000 foreigners who applied for asylum in the United States.

Ex-NBA player tells Laura Ingraham why WNBA can't ban him: 'I identify as a woman'. Enes Kanter Freedom reveals exactly what Natasha Cloud screamed at him courtside before security ejected him from the Indiana Fever-Chicago Sky game.

John Harbaugh calls it 'reasonable to assume' Malik Nabers will be available for Giants in Week 1 vs Cowboys. Malik Nabers shed his red non-contact jersey at Giants training camp, and head coach John Harbaugh said it's reasonable to assume he'll play Week 1.

Utah teen charged with killing mother, 8-year-old brother as mystery of final hours unravels: police. The Utah juvenile murder case against the 17-year-old includes surveillance audio allegedly capturing an argument and three gunshots inside the family's home.

Sydney Sweeney tells Tom Cruise to 'watch out' after strapping herself to top of airplane. Sydney Sweeney's video shows her strapped atop a flipping airplane, prompting the official "Top Gun" Instagram account to respond to her Tom Cruise joke.

Can Trump's economic war against Iran do what airstrikes and negotiations couldn't?. What a new round of U.S. sanctions could mean after nearly six months of war with Iran — and years of economic pressure on the country.

At least 25% of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had CTE, study finds. Playing football has long been linked to the brain disease known as CTE, but how prevalent it is is still unknown. A new study of former NFL players who died recently found that at least 25% had CTE.
When is suspending students discrimination? Education Dept. renews an old fight. President Trump's Education Department is telling schools to stop considering race when it comes to school discipline.

Kids with brain injuries thrive at this camp. But federal research funding is in flux. A Pennsylvania summer camp helps children who have survived brain injuries. But the future of federal funding for brain injury research, as well as grants to states to help such patients, is in limbo.

Spokane wildfire evacuees return home, but it's 'still a hazmat situation'. Most evacuees have been allowed to return to their homes near burn zones in Spokane, despite concerns about lingering toxins.
